# Governed landing queue. One pull request per line, in the order the schedule lands them.
# A dependency is `451 depends: 417` or `451 depends: 417,451` (numbers numerically sorted).
# The schedule stops at the first refusal of a pull request that a later line depends on.
# A line that names no dependency and is refused does not stop the rest of the queue.
# An empty queue lands nothing. Adding a line is itself a governed change.
